description:
FILED s473t5d (Opus, 2026-09-13) by #1501 round 5 CHECK 2.

`tools/pclperl-for-tests` accepts `-d` / `-d:Module` and IGNORES it, which is
the right thing for the harness (the child must not crash) but means every
assertion about the debugger fails with empty output.

WHAT THE 21 ROWS ASK FOR (t/run/switchd.t, t/run/switchd-78586.t): `DB::DB`
called per statement under `-d`, `$DB::sub`, `%DB::sub`, `%DB::lsub`,
`*DB::dbline` aliasing, `${"_<-e"}` (the source-line array per file),
`DB::goto`, subroutine redefinition visible to the debugger, and
`-d:whatever` not throwing line numbers off.

This is perl's debugger HOOK MODEL, not a switch: `-d` sets `$^P` and makes the
compiler emit a `DB::DB` call before each statement and populate `%DB::sub` and
`@{"_<$filename"}`.  PCL has none of it, and adding it is a compile-model
feature (an emission mode), so this is a SIZE-FIRST task, not a filler.

Related: #1702 (the `#!perl -d:...` spellings reach it through the shebang
line, so that task's rows overlap two of these).

ROWS: 19 + 2 blessed fail rows; no shortfall (both files run to their end).
subject: the `-d` debugger is absent: t/run/switchd.t (19 rows) and t/run/switchd-78586.t (2) assert DB::DB / %DB::sub / ${"_<FILE"} behaviour that PCL has no model for
